ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $D$, $E$, $F$ are points on $AB$, $AC$, and $BC$, respectively, and $DE \parallel BC$, $EF \parallel AB$. If $BF:FC=2:3$ and $AB=15$, then what is the value of $BD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\[
\text{{Solution:}} \quad \because \text{{ DE }} \parallel \text{{ BC}}, \text{{ EF }} \parallel \text{{ AB}}, \\
\therefore \text{{ quadrilateral BFED is a parallelogram, }} \triangle \text{{ EFC }} \sim \triangle \text{{ ABC}}, \\
\therefore \frac{{EF}}{{AB}} = \frac{{CF}}{{CB}}, \text{{ EF }} = \text{{ BD }}, \\
\because \text{{ BF:FC }} = 2:3, \text{{ AB }} = 15, \\
\therefore \text{{ EF }} = \frac{3}{5}\text{{ AB }} = 9, \\
\therefore \text{{ BD }} = \boxed{9};
\]
